body.statement: When a CPU halts at peak on \TORBANK, suspending $STMT1 and raising ATM-AUTH NUMSTATIC by 8 restores ATM p95 to band within about 2 minutes.

subject: $STMT1
ATM-AUTH
CPU 5
structured.condition: Peak day, one CPU down, ATM-AUTH lost servers
structured.assertion: Suspending the noon batch and adding 8 static servers recovers ATM latency
structured.rationale: INC-0001: ATM p95 back in band 60 s after both actions; CPU 5 at 80%
